description: Eight synthetic candidates. Every person, employer and institution is invented; no real CV appears here and none should. Each candidate declares the CV text and the profile items an extractor would produce from it, with the passage each item is drawn from. The harness verifies those passages against the CV text using the real verifier, so evidence verification is genuinely exercised rather than assumed.

candidates.purpose: Strong match. The ordinary case, and the baseline the counterfactual twin is compared against.
